result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall (layout, spacing, navigation, and imagery are consistent). One notable content anomaly was found: a promotional badge showing a '−100%' discount on the pizza restaurant card, which is almost certainly an incorrect value. A minor redundancy was also noted on the ramen card.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' displays a '−100%' discount badge. A 100% discount implies the order is completely free, which is implausible and looks like a data/calculation error (e.g., missing or zero price used in the percentage formula, or a wrong field mapped to the badge).
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount data source for this restaurant and cap/validate the discount percentage (e.g., only show badges for values between 1% and 99%). If the intended promo is free delivery, use the '€0 delivery' badge style used on the ramen card instead.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, '€0 delivery' appears twice — once as an overlay badge on the image and again in the metadata line below the title — which is redundant.
issues.suggestion: Show the delivery fee in one place only (e.g., keep the badge and drop it from the metadata line, or vice versa) to reduce visual noise.
